442.issue_title: Fix git_push false-success reporting and upstream result detection

cycles.name: Adapter PushInfo Validation

deliverables.description: Unit tests in test_git_adapter.py validating observable push outcomes (remote rejection, empty result list, hook refusal, up-to-date, new head) via public adapter.push() API
GitAdapter.push() implementation validating PushInfoList flags and raising ExecutionError on failure

cycles.exit_criteria: GitAdapter.push() raises ExecutionError with remote summary when PushInfo.ERROR, REJECTED, REMOTE_REJECTED, REMOTE_FAILURE is set or list is empty; returns None on valid successes; all adapter tests pass.

cycles.name: Manager Tracking Delta & Domain Contract

deliverables.description: Unit tests in test_git_manager.py testing upstream state delta calculation, preexisting tracking retention, and failed tracking verification via public manager.push() API
GitPushResult dataclass and GitManager.push() returning GitPushResult

cycles.exit_criteria: GitManager.push() calculates new_upstream_created accurately based on pre/post push tracking state; raises ExecutionError if set_upstream=True fails to establish tracking; all manager unit tests pass.

cycles.name: Tool Async Execution & DTO Mapping

deliverables.description: Unit tests in test_git_tools.py testing GitPushTool.execute() success mapping, dynamic new_upstream_created propagation, and exception bubbling to decorator pipeline
GitPushTool.execute() refactored with anyio.to_thread.run_sync and GitPushResult mapping

cycles.exit_criteria: GitPushTool executes asynchronously, maps all domain fields to GitPushOutput, and passes all tool tests.

cycles.name: Integration Verification & Quality Gates

deliverables.description: Integration test suite verification confirming submit-pr rollback and recovery behavior
Quality gates verification (Pylint 10.00/10.00, strict Mypy 0 errors, branch coverage >= 90%)

cycles.exit_criteria: All unit and integration test suites pass; strict quality gates pass with zero warnings or errors.
